# EnterpriseGlue v0.35.1 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.35.0`.

## Highlights

- **runtime-dependencies:** Repair runtime and browser/build dependency vulnerabilities in MSAL, parsing, mail, HTTP, schema validation, DOMPurify and Vite/Vitest while preserving database adapters and tenant controls.

## User and administrator impact

- Authentication and tenant isolation retain their existing application behavior while runtime dependency vulnerabilities are repaired.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- Upgrade the host and published workspace packages together after exact-candidate qualification.
- Standalone package consumers must reproduce the scoped Azure Identity 4.13.2 to MSAL Node 7.1.0 root override and qualify their installed dependency closure.

## API and integration compatibility

- Remove the unused optional MSAL peer requirement from the shared package; no shared public types or runtime imports use MSAL.

## Configuration

- No new runtime configuration is required.

## Database migrations

- Migration inventories and schema-plan identities remain unchanged.
- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- Pin MSAL Node 7.1.0 directly and in Azure Identity 4.13.2 through a scoped workspace override; real Tedious credential compatibility regressions preserve token acquisition, cache separation and refusals.
- Require body-parser 2.4.0, fast-uri 3.1.9, nodemailer 10.1.4, undici 7.30.1 and zod 4.6.6 or later within their existing major release lines; the lockfile resolves zod 4.6.7.
- Require DOMPurify 3.4.17 for browser sanitization and patched Vite 7.3.7 and Vitest 4.1.12 in the managed build/test dependency closure; preserve the existing security policy.
- Set explicit Brotli vendor package floors in runtime assemblies so cached build layers cannot retain the vulnerable revision.
- Use a digest-pinned Alpine 3.24 runtime and an explicit Node 24.22.1 security floor in the installer and manager, retaining the Node 24 major.
- Pin the Wolfi backend to Node 24.22.1-r2 and bootstrap to Node 26.12.1-r2 with c-ares 1.34.9-r0 or later, preserving each runtime major and the frozen bootstrap code/schema contract.
- Retain the existing scanner severity and ignore policy; final release images require current exact-image security qualification.

## Documentation

- docs/runbooks/security-dependency-updates.md documents the Azure Identity override, standalone consumer boundary and required runtime qualification.

## Known limitations

- The scoped root override does not automatically propagate to standalone npm consumers.
- Synthetic HTTP credential compatibility tests do not establish live Azure authentication or SaaS tenant isolation.

## Rollback

- Restore the previous package set only after independently verifying current security acceptance; earlier signed image bytes alone are insufficient.

## Validation evidence

- Source builds, typechecks, unit regressions, package/runtime checks, PostgreSQL 16 compatibility and exact-image security qualification are required for this dependency set.
- Exact-candidate native image scans, all five database adapters and the pinned real-engine browser gate remain required before publication.
